d:
The Bulls defeated the Nets, 137-107 tonight in Brooklyn. Matas Buzelis contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 5 rebounds 5 three pointers and 4 assists, with Josh Giddey of the Bulls adding an additional 18 points (8-12 FG, 1-4 3P) in the game. Egor Dëmin finished with a team-high 22 points along with 4 rebounds for the Nets in the losing effort. The Bulls improve their record to 4-10 with the win, while the Nets fall to 3-11 for the season.
